name: grain-flow
title: Grain flow
description: Sheets of cobalt light flow past a navy valley under film grain. It loops with no join.

props.name: ground
props.doc: The dark valley between the sheets (navy black).

props.name: deep
props.doc: The body colour of the sheets (cobalt).

props.name: bright
props.doc: The lit part of the sheets toward their corners (sky blue).

props.name: glow
props.doc: The hottest light, in the lower-left corner (ice white).

props.name: flow
props.doc: How far the sheets bend and travel over the loop. 1 is a slow liquid drift.

props.name: speed
props.doc: Loops per 10 seconds. Whole numbers loop seamlessly.
